name: Paperclip
description: Runs teams of coding and business agents as a self-hosted company with an org chart, ticketed tasks, heartbeats, budgets, and approval gates, managed from a web UI, CLI, or REST API.

skills.name: Agent Heartbeats
skills.description: Wakes each agent for assigned tasks, follow-up messages, or configured schedules, with delegation flowing up and down the org chart.

skills.name: Budgets And Cost Control
skills.description: Sets company, agent, and project budgets, tracks reported spend with threshold alerts, and pauses work when a configured limit is hit.

skills.name: Review And Approvals
skills.description: Adds review and approval stages to tasks and agent hires, and lets you pause, reassign, or stop an agent's work when needed.

skills.name: Scheduled Routines
skills.description: Runs recurring work on cron, webhook, or API triggers, with each run creating a tracked issue and waking the assigned agent.

skills.name: Ready-Made Teams
skills.description: Previews and installs ready-made teams with roles, skills, projects, and routines, then lets you choose each agent's runtime.
